Titel: Data Migration Lead SAP S/4HANA (f/m/d)
Unternehmen: Graufels Pharma AG
Ort: Zürich (Schweiz)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4187502871/
Abgerufen am: 12.09.2026 09:30

About the job
Graufels Pharma is moving its global finance and supply chain processes to SAP S/4HANA. We are hiring a Data Migration Lead to own the migration of master and transactional data across twelve legal entities.

Your responsibilities
Define the migration strategy, object list and load sequence
Lead a team of four data analysts and coordinate the system integrator
Design mappings and transformation rules together with the business data owners
Run mock loads with the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and SAP Data Services
Establish data quality KPIs, reconciliation and sign-off procedures for GxP relevant data
Plan the data cutover together with the programme lead

Your profile
University degree in business informatics or a comparable field
At least six years of experience in SAP data migration, including two S/4HANA projects
Hands-on knowledge of the Migration Cockpit (LTMC/LTMOM), SQL and reconciliation reporting
Experience in a regulated environment (GMP/GxP) is a strong advantage
Fluent English; German is an advantage

What we offer
Permanent full-time position
Annual salary CHF 145,000 to 165,000 plus bonus
Hybrid working with three days per week on site in Zürich
Relocation support
